images.screen: A · 작업대 검사 (상자 #0731 · 주인 후보 장부)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Top-down inspection job simulator in the vein of Papers, Please and Quarantine Zone, but tactile and painterly: a Korean post-office lost-parcel sorting desk seen straight from above, olive-green linoleum with scuffs, cold fluorescent light with a warm desk-lamp pool. Left half: an opened kraft cardboard box with torn brown tape and shredded paper, its contents laid out on the desk: a pair of small green children's hiking socks, a white pharmacy medicine envelope with a red cross and handwritten dosage, a black power bank that is visibly swollen and bulging with a yellow-black hazard tag '위험물 의심', and a small enamel mountain-club pin badge. A violet ultraviolet hand lamp is held over the badge, revealing a faint glowing handwritten mark on its back. Paper clue tags pinned to items with short labels such as '아동 190mm', '하구약국 · 윤○희', '청솔산악회'; thin red threads run from the tags to a clipboard on the right. The clipboard is a resident ledger '주민 대장' with three candidate cards with small illustrated portraits: a woman about 40 highlighted with '일치 3/4', an older woman with '일치 2/4', and a window claim form '창구 신청서' stamped in red '모순 2'. Below the box a tool tray with three tools labeled '돋보기 +90초', '자외선 +120초', '집게 +60초', and a small red-striped hazard bin '위험물 통'. Bottom right: three big rubber-stamp buttons '배송 확정' (red), '보류함 1/3' (ochre), '폐기' (grey). Bottom strip: a conveyor of waiting parcels, one tied with a distinctive blue string knot. Top HUD as painted metal plates: '분실물 창고', '12일차', quota '07 / 16', '평판 64', amber seven-segment clock '14:32', '퇴근 18:00'. Painterly semi-realistic illustration, kraft browns, olive, cream paper, stamp red, UV violet accent, fine grain, soft vignette. All Korean text crisp and correctly spelled.

images.screen: B · 13번 선반 (주인 없는 상자가 드러나는 순간)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same lost-parcel depot after hours, 21:40, room in deep navy darkness, one green-shaded desk lamp casting amber light, plus a strong violet ultraviolet lamp glow. Left: a tall wooden pigeonhole shelf labeled '13번 선반' with thirty numbered cubbies; seven hold identical kraft boxes each tied with the same blue string knot, the eighth cubby is empty and glowing, counter '8 / 30'. Center-top: a cork board titled '주인 없는 상자 — 한 사람의 연표' with a red thread timeline marked with years 1968, 1977, 1984, 1988, 1991, 1995, 2002, 2003; pinned small Polaroid-like item cards along it: a baby's swaddling jacket, a school name tag '3-2 여은수', a bundle of pen-pal letters, a cassette tape, a civil-service acceptance letter, a bus commuter pass, a single red hand-knitted child's mitten; the 2003 slot is an empty dashed frame glowing yellow. Foreground desk: the eighth opened box with a blue knot, its items under the UV lamp: an old post-office employee ID card where glowing violet ink reveals '하구 우편집중국 · 제3 분류대 · 여은수', a small worn wooden name seal, and a folded memo. A dramatic caption plate reads '제3 분류대 — 지금 당신이 앉은 자리다.' Right edge: a small end-of-day ledger card '오늘 정산' with lines '정확 배송 14', '오배송 클레임 1', '사기 신청 적발 1', '평판 64 → 66', and a yellow button '13일차 ▸'. Painterly semi-realistic illustration, chiaroscuro, deep blue shadows, amber lamp, UV violet glow, film grain, heavy vignette, quiet uncanny mystery mood. All Korean text crisp and correctly spelled.
